sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_index" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "uri" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_lower" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NULL, "kind" INTEGER NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "modified_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "taken_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "sort_date_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "width" INTEGER NULL, "height" INTEGER NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "folder_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" INTEGER NOT NULL, "indexed_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "scan_generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, "screenshot" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("screenshot" IN (0, 1)), "source" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hidden" IN (0, 1)), "extension" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "preset_id" INTEGER NULL, "layout" TEXT NOT NULL, "filter" TEXT NULL, "delete_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'trash', "cursor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cursor_file_id" TEXT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "ended_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_actions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "previous_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("session_id", "seq"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_deletes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "action_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES session_actions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "failure_reason" TEXT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "file_modified_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "committed_mode" TEXT NULL, "queued_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "committed_at" INTEGER NULL, "trash_id" TEXT NULL, "left_trash_at" INTEGER NULL, "left_trash_reason" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_folder_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "stored_path" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "volume_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "original_file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_modified_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("name"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "file_tags" ("file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("file_id", "tag_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "favorites" ("file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("file_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rename_batches" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "pattern_json" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "applied_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rename_batch_items" ("batch_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES rename_batches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "folder_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "current_file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "current_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "new_name" TEXT NULL, "temp_name" TEXT NULL, "skipped" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("skipped" IN (0, 1)), "skip_reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("batch_id", "file_id"), UNIQUE ("batch_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "presets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "layout_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "filter_json" TEXT NULL, "include_reviewed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("include_reviewed" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reviewed_labels" ("action_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "preset_key" INTEGER NOT NULL, "action_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "action_detail" TEXT NULL, "reviewed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "file_modified_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("action_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "selection_items" ("file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("file_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "selection_snapshots" ("file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("file_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "swipe_sources" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "filter_json" TEXT NULL, "item_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "group_count" INTEGER NULL, "return_route" TEXT NULL, "opened_after_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "closed_at_seq" INTEGER NULL, "opened_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "closed_at" INTEGER NULL, CHECK ((kind = 'filter') = (filter_json IS NOT NULL)), CHECK ((kind = 'groups') = (group_count IS NOT NULL)), CHECK ((closed_at IS NULL) = (closed_at_seq IS NULL)), CHECK (kind <> 'outside' OR closed_at IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "swipe_source_items" ("source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES swipe_sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_index" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "image_signals" ("file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "d_hash" INTEGER NULL, "blur_score" REAL NULL, "file_modified_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "algo_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("file_id"), CHECK ((status = 'ok') = (d_hash IS NOT NULL AND blur_score IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "similar_groups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "suggested_file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "member_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_date_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "similar_group_items" ("group_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES similar_groups (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("group_id", "file_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "similar_dismissed" ("file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "dismissed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("file_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_locations" ("file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_modified_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lat" REAL NULL, "lng" REAL NULL, "front_camera" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("front_camera" IN (0, 1)), "location_readable" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("location_readable" IN (0, 1)), "read_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("file_id"), CHECK ((lat IS NULL) = (lng IS NULL)), CHECK (lat IS NULL OR lat BETWEEN -90 AND 90), CHECK (lng IS NULL OR lng BETWEEN -180 AND 180));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "smart_groups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "rank" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "center_lat" REAL NULL, "center_lng" REAL NULL, "cover_file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "user_title" TEXT NULL, "place_name" TEXT NULL, "geocoded_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, CHECK ((center_lat IS NULL) = (center_lng IS NULL)), CHECK (end_at_ms >= start_at_ms));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "smart_group_items" ("group_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES smart_groups (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("group_id", "file_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_labels" ("file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "confidence" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("file_id", "label"), CHECK (confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_label_status" ("file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL, "model_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "file_modified_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "error" TEXT NULL, "processed_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("file_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "known_devices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "peer_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform" TEXT NOT NULL, "public_key_fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "last_seen_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_addresses" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "allowed_roots_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "can_share_to_us" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("can_share_to_us" IN (0, 1)), "is_temporary" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_temporary" IN (0, 1)), "auto_accept" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_accept" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(public_key_fingerprint) = 64));
CREATE INDEX mi_kind_date ON media_index (kind, sort_date_ms)
CREATE INDEX mi_kind_size ON media_index (kind, size_bytes)
CREATE INDEX mi_folder_date ON media_index (folder_path, sort_date_ms)
CREATE INDEX mi_date ON media_index (sort_date_ms)
CREATE INDEX mi_name ON media_index (name_lower)
CREATE INDEX mi_screenshot_date ON media_index (screenshot, sort_date_ms)
CREATE INDEX mi_source_date ON media_index (source, sort_date_ms)
CREATE INDEX mi_ext ON media_index (extension)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_active_session ON sessions (is_active) WHERE is_active = 1
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_open_session_per_preset ON sessions (COALESCE(preset_id, 0)) WHERE ended_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX sa_session_status_seq ON session_actions (session_id, status, seq)
CREATE INDEX pd_session_status ON pending_deletes (session_id, status)
CREATE INDEX pfi_expires ON pending_folder_items (expires_at)
CREATE INDEX ft_tag ON file_tags (tag_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_collecting_batch ON rename_batches (session_id) WHERE status = 'collecting'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX presets_name_nocase ON presets (name COLLATE NOCASE)
CREATE INDEX rl_file_preset ON reviewed_labels (file_id, preset_key)
CREATE INDEX rl_preset ON reviewed_labels (preset_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_open_source_per_session ON swipe_sources (session_id) WHERE closed_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX ss_session_closed_seq ON swipe_sources (session_id, closed_at_seq)
CREATE INDEX ssi_file ON swipe_source_items (file_id)
CREATE INDEX is_blur ON image_signals (blur_score)
CREATE INDEX sgi_file ON similar_group_items (file_id)
CREATE INDEX sg_kind_rank ON smart_groups (kind, rank)
CREATE INDEX smgi_file ON smart_group_items (file_id)
CREATE INDEX ai_labels_label ON ai_labels (label, file_id)
